Retail analytics services

Retail and e-commerce analytics services for local stores and online sellers

Data Fort helps locally owned retail and e-commerce businesses use sales and inventory reporting, customer retention analysis, product performance reporting, and margin visibility to make clearer decisions. The service is built for owners and staff who need practical business intelligence without a dedicated data team.

Pain points

  • Store, online, accounting, and spreadsheet reports do not line up cleanly.
  • Sales totals are visible, but repeat customer and product performance patterns are harder to interpret.
  • Inventory reports show counts, but not always slow movers, stockout risk, or margin impact.
  • Campaign or promotion performance is difficult to connect to profitable buyers.

Sample metrics

  • Repeat purchase rate, lapsed customers, and customer segments.
  • Top products, slow movers, bundle performance, and category trends.
  • Inventory turnover, stockout risk, and aged inventory.
  • Sales, gross margin, average order value, and channel performance.

Decisions enabled

  • Which products should be protected from stockouts before peak periods.
  • Which customers should receive replenishment, loyalty, or win-back offers.
  • Which product categories deserve more buying, merchandising, or promotion attention.
  • Which sales and inventory reporting questions should guide the next month.

Local fit

For retail and e-commerce businesses in Toronto and the GTA

Data Fort supports retail analytics services and e-commerce analytics services for small businesses in Toronto, North York, Richmond Hill, Thornhill, Vaughan, Newmarket, Markham, Etobicoke, and Scarborough.

Reporting outcome

A clearer view of products, customers, and margins

Retail and e-commerce analytics should help owners see what is selling, who is coming back, what is tying up cash, and where margin is improving or weakening.
